rationale: Customer name is mandatory biographical data. Evidence shows 0% missing.

rule: Name must use Title Case format (flag all lowercase or all uppercase words except known particles)
rationale: Evidence shows dominant Title Case convention with one all-lowercase violation ('lim wei jie') and potential all-caps entries. Malay/Indian particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o) are exempted.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
rationale: Evidence shows multicultural names with gender-encoding particles: 'Bin' and 's/o' indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' indicate female. Mismatches indicate data inconsistency.

check_params.logic:
import re
name = str(row['Name'])
gender = str(row['Gender']).strip().lower()
male_particle = bool(re.search(r'\b(Bin|s/o)\b', name, re.IGNORECASE))
female_particle = bool(re.search(r'\b(Binte|d/o)\b', name, re.IGNORECASE))
(male_particle and gender != 'male') or (female_particle and gender != 'female')
